verdict.rationale: AMD's docs mention PCIe 5.0 storage support, NVMe boot/RAID modes, and ECC support, giving some concrete I/O planning data, but there is no explicit breakdown of PCIe lane counts, external connectivity (USB/Thunderbolt) specs, or a full I/O diagram that a developer would need to plan a dock/build around. missing for 10: PCIe lane count/topology details, USB/Thunderbolt/USB4 external port specs, and independent verification of these figures beyond AMD's own product page.
